messages:
zoe_cs: Heads-up - VertexAI Labs wants to move their renewal up and extend from 12mo to 18mo in exchange for a blended rate. They asked for the change this week. Current ARR $240k/yr. Procurement requires PO + signed DPA. Can we coordinate?

dan_sales: I spoke to their procurement. They propose 8% off list if we do 18 months and include 1 month free credit. CFO will sign but needs vendor code. Also asking for monthly invoices.

sophie_legal: We need to add the DPA and clarify data-residency text. If Sales is approving term extension + credit, add language: "one-time promotional credit applied to first invoice" and a non-negotiable approval matrix. I'll draft.

henry_fin: Finance prefers Net45, but monthly invoicing is OK if we accept PO. We need vendor code VC-102. Also confirm whether the 1-month credit is booked as revenue deferral.

ravi_enable: Enablement can set up a 45-min technical kickoff within 3 business days of signature. Would like list of 3 technical owners and primary use-cases to tailor the session. We'll also include a 4-question feedback pulse after onboarding.

tess_se: SE notes: account health flagged a latency regression in gen endpoints after last deploy. Recommend pre-kickoff remediation notes: scale up concurrent workers for first 2 weeks and enable prefix cache. I'll attach a short runbook excerpt.

billing_bot: New PO request created: PO-VC-9876 awaiting vendor code confirmation.

zoe_cs: Action list: @sophie_legal to draft DPA + contract update; @henry_fin confirm vendor code and invoicing terms; @dan_sales finalize discount approval; @ravi_enable collect tech contacts; @tess_se prep remediation notes.

sophie_legal: Draft posted: https://drive.company/contracts/vertexai_dpa_draft. Added clause: "promotional credit applied to first invoice; no further concessions without VP Sales sign-off." PTAL.

henry_fin: Vendor code confirmed VC-102. Monthly invoice cadence OK; Net45 terms still required on main contract. We'll accept PO-VC-9876 if it references VC-102.

dan_sales: Leadership approved 7% + 1-month credit (not 8%). I'm updating the commercial summary and will send to the buyer.

tess_se: Short runbook snippet we recommend:

```
replica.pool.size = 4
inference.cache.prefix_kv = true
monitoring.alert.token_rate > 1200 => scale-up
```

oe_cs: Sophie, once the DPA + contract reflect 7% + credit and vendor code, who will send DocuSign?

sophie_legal: I'll finish redline and hand to Dan for sending. ETA 12:00 PST tomorrow.

ravi_enable: I'll draft the invite template and survey now; need primary contacts (name + email) for scheduling.

henry_fin: Finance note: booking guidance - account will be treated as 18-month term with revenue deferral for the free month. Reach out to me for ARR impact sheet.

dan_sales: Sent DocuSign -> https://docusign.company/vertexai_xyz (signers: CFO, procurement lead). Included vendor code VC-102 in the tag. Adding @zoe_cs as cc.

zoe_cs: Monitoring. Please flag if signature delays >5 business days. I'll log the renewal in Gainsight and set "early renewal" flag.

billing_bot: DocuSign envelope status: completed at 5999992260. PO-VC-9876 received and matched to VC-102. Invoice terms: monthly, Net45.

tess_se: Scheduling: Technical kickoff set for Apr 15 09:30 PT (45min). I'll circulate runbook and perf checklist.

ravi_enable: Enablement session confirmed. Post-session survey link to be sent; question includes: "Why did you choose to extend early?"

zoe_cs: Closing this thread: contract signed, PO in, kickoff scheduled. Will share survey results after enablement. Thanks team :tada:
